description: This file defines an abstract generic class AbstractDataPopulator used for data transformation between Source and Target types within a sales management system. It handles locale settings and provides a template method for populating data, also defining some common functionality and contract for subclasses.

classes.name: AbstractDataPopulator
classes.description: An abstract class providing a base for transforming data from a source object to a target object, including locale management.

methods.name: setLocale
methods.description: Sets the locale used during data population.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Populates a target object from a source object using store and language context; delegates to abstract method for actual creation of target.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Abstract method to instantiate a new target object.
